result.question: What was Tesla's operating income in fiscal year 2025?
result.answer: Tesla's operating income (income from operations) in fiscal year 2025 was $4,355 million, as reported in its 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025 [0001628280-26-003952:item-8-p007]. This was down from $7,076 million in fiscal year 2024 [0001628280-26-003952:item-8-p007].
